hero.title: School management in one place
hero.body: Grading, attendance, assignments, admissions, announcements, and approvals for teachers, students, parents, and school staff.

profile.title: About SchoMans Demo School
profile.body: SchoMans Demo School is a fictional school of 150 students in five classes, made to show how a school can run its attendance, grades, assignments, admissions and announcements in one place. Every name and number on this site is made up.
